canonicalStatement: For every finite local dimension d >= 2, a homogeneous open nearest-neighbour chain H_N=sum_i |psi><psi|_(i,i+1), N >= 2, with a normalised forbidden vector of Schmidt probabilities (1/2,1/2,0,...), is gapless precisely when psi=(u tensor w - w tensor v)/sqrt(2) up to phase, with unit u,v,w and w perpendicular to u,v. Every such gapless chain has gamma_N=1-cos(pi/N). All other interactions in this class are uniformly gapped. Local projector rank is ONE; forbidden-vector Schmidt rank is TWO.
evidence: Finite producer replay; written universal arguments remain unformalised.
